title: Inlandboatmen’s Union of the Pacific — Marine Division of the ILWU
description: A labor union representing mariners and inland waterway workers on the U.S. West Coast (including Alaska and Hawaii). It covers crews of ferries, tugboats, barges, dredges, tour boats, and related shoreside personnel. Engages in collective bargaining, protects workers’ rights, and provides member benefits. Founded in 1918.Once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator. https://ibu.org/
